rows.Kwic: 趨炎附暖底不顧爛額焦頭、添薪熾炭底那管眉毛墮落？

Override.AttributionNote: 內紹種禪師語錄, hall address on Baizhang, Longtan, Deshan, and Linji. Neishao Zhong is the exact speaker: he says those adding fuel and blazing coals pay no heed to their eyebrows falling out.
